summary: The per-frame update virtuals (+20h) of the three central in-mission HUD screens, read end to end from the listing. All three are __thiscall(this, float) and RET 4. The HUD root and the markers screen are reconstructed in full; the minimap's animation block and unit-icon pass are reconstructed and the rest is analyzed.

globals.00E188D8: the controlled unit; 00644230 is the whole accessor
globals.00F88A00: float gating the reinforcement sweep against 0.03; not identified
globals.0109CF04: the platform singleton; byte +0Dh insets the HUD root's first row
globals.00E197C4..00E197D8: six floats the markers update publishes as the marker clip rectangle

routines.name: BSP_InGameHudRootScreen_Update
routines.screen: registry slot 44h, the HUD root at manager +40h

gate.note: the tail from 00649FB3 runs on every call regardless of the gate

per_entry_filter.behaviour: descriptor type at [[entry+4]+8]: type 3 compares the scope byte at [[entry+4]+84h] (4 means same unit+180h, 5 means same unit+54h); type 2 scans sixteen 0Ch-byte list heads at [00F88C30+84h+i*0Ch] for an entry whose +8h is this power-up and that passes 008E4680

placement.row_accumulator: a stack slot, not a register; the pseudocode aliases it to the loop counter

the state select that follows every 00AB64C0 add
compares then writes +F4h, +F8h, +100h and +104h and re-emits through virtual +7Ch; called as (fill, 0, 0, 1) on the circle clone
widget_writes.uncertainty: the owning widget class and the meaning of the four components were not established

widget_writes.behaviour: every clone is shown immediately after CloneSubtree

unconditional_tail.role: message ticker: +BCh -= delta while positive; on expiry with a non-empty queue at +B0h..+B4h (stride 10h), 00648060 runs and +BCh reloads 7
the pending unit handle at +78h, resolved through the handle table 00F89A10/00F89A0C/00F89A54 and 00F89A60/00F89AA8, filtered on +5Ch set with +5Dh, +60h, +5Eh clear
00645060 with the unit in ECX, the local team index in EDX and a literal 1 on the stack; the EDX load at 0064A085 is invisible in the pseudocode, so this is not __thiscall(this, 1)
interface request 34h (INTF_LIMBO) with payload 0 when there is no controlled unit and the manager is idle ([00E198C4+4h]==[+20h] and [+1Ch]==[+38h])
interface request 20h (INTF_SCENE3D) with the unit's virtual +140h as payload, after 0059DA80 and 005251C0
00644CC0(&out, unit); when the word at out+2h is FFFFh the value comes from 00644C20 instead; stored unaligned at this+C2h
